qs.q: What does a Vaccine Vial Monitor (VVM) inner square matching the color of the outer circle indicate?
o: The vaccine is completely fresh and potent with zero heat exposure
The inner square is lighter than the outer circle, meaning it is safe
The color of the inner square matches the outer circle, representing Stage 3
The inner square is darker than the outer circle, indicating discard
qs.e: Stage 3 is defined as the color of the inner square matching the outer circle due to combined time and temperature exposure. Stage 1 has an inner square lighter than the outer circle.

qs.q: What does a Vaccine Vial Monitor (VVM) stage 3 indicate about a vaccine vial?
o: Inner square is lighter than the outer circle
Inner square matches the outer circle
Inner square is darker than the outer circle
qs.e: Stage 3 occurs when the color of the inner square matches the outer circle, signaling the threshold of heat exposure. Stage 4 would show an inner square darker than the outer circle.
